Engineers on the team use data to discover opportunities for improvement, implement A/B tests to validate ideas, and work across the product to iteratively improve UX and reduce friction for new customers. * Demonstrated ability and success in using AI\-driven software delivery practices and methods and/or a willingness and excitement to learn.
* Thrives in an entrepreneurial type environment that is fast paced, customer focused, and strategic.

* HTML, TypeScript, JavaScript, React
